policy: Curated sentence cards. German on the front is verbatim source text; answers are verified in a source snapshot or are the learner's own captured sentence. No audio, no multiple choice, no mirrors.

cards.scene: Ask an adult you don't know well how they are (formal, Sie).
Ask a friend how they are (informal, du) — full form.

cards.scene: Article table, nominative (with sein): the masculine row.
